acceptance: Every preserved block is found exactly once in forward source order within its declared page/segment, with no normalization, rewriting, overlap, duplication, or unexplained source gap.

Only high-confidence allowlisted removal decisions remove text; all preserve-only types and medium/low-confidence decisions remain, and broad or entire-page removals generate prominent warnings and review evidence.

Prompts contain real canonical source exactly once inside page/segment markers with all placeholders resolved; response schema, window ID, sequential IDs, page indices, enums, non-empty blocks, and preserved-text fidelity are validated before checkpoint or output formatting.
Request sizing reserves prompt, complete source repeated in JSON, escaping/field overhead, configurable expansion, and safety margin; impossible profiles fail before provider submission.

Only fully validated windows are checkpointed; legacy/incompatible or changed-input checkpoints restart safely, while changed-profile resume continues from the next validated window and records model history.

Original extraction, cleaned text, decision report, warnings, state, transaction log, side-by-side preview, and manual Save workflow support human review; focused tests, regression, traceability, coverage, style, and documentation audits pass.
assumptions: Preserved-text fidelity is exact after one canonical CRLF-to-LF conversion; removable high-confidence block text and subtype are advisory, but each discarded interval requires at least one such decision.

The removable allowlist is running_header, running_footer, page_number, copyright_notice, extraction_noise, and ocr_noise. Narration, dialogue, chapter_heading, epigraph, scene_separator, and unknown are always preserved, as are all medium/low-confidence blocks.
Broad prefixes and entire pages may be removed when authorized, but they produce prominent human-review warnings rather than hard rejection.
Window selection targets four consecutive pages when capacity permits and shrinks to three, two, one, or newline/paragraph-bounded segments as necessary.

The initial configurable response-expansion default is the conservative 2.0 factor; deterministic budget tests evaluate 1.5, 1.75, and 2.0 policies and prove max_output_tokens sufficiency before provider submission.

Checkpoints lacking schema_version lossless_blocks_v1 or matching input/instruction identity restart from the first window; a changed enabled profile may resume only at the next fully validated window and records model history.
data.reason: The product component is high criticality, but this development execution is local, reversible, bounded to the adopted AI Cleanup component, specified by a detailed approved plan, uses deterministic fake-provider red/green tests, retains original text and mandatory human review, and performs no live cleanup or external delivery action.
